purpose: Mixed-period observation diagnostic: does site area predict encountered residential-property density beyond a constant-density baseline in this selected housing archive? This is not AD150 population calibration, a fantasy allocator comparison, or prospective transfer.
known_before_declaration: All50 Table2 rows, household3/5/7 calculations and sampling fractions already exposed. Three phases explicitly excludeAD150;47 unresolved;all50 lack phase-compatible extent and representativeness certificates. Workbook links404,ORA403;no certified city join. No new regression, prediction or score computed.
units: One author-supplied city key per row. Require unique keys AND unique exact normalized ancient-name/province pairs. No fuzzy joins, dates or missing extents filled;all source rows retained in primary analysis. Catalogue joins remain uncertified and no cross-archive independence is asserted.
response: Natural logarithm(properties/sample_area_ha), a sampled property density. Site area is a predictor, never part of the response. Do not fit extrapolated population against area and describe the shared area factor as independent evidence. No random-sampling likelihood, inferential confidence interval or census assumption.

models.status: Observation-selection diagnostic only. Coverage includes the response denominator; association cannot certify representativeness or a causal urban effect. Not an allocator predictor.

fit: Ordinary least squares with one equal weight per city and no tuning/clipping. Refuse rank-deficient/nonfinite fits. Fit every coefficient using training rows only.
groups: Leave one exact source province label out at a time. Italia regions remain distinct source labels. Report every fold, training/test sizes and coefficient ranges. This is coarse geography blocking of exposed observations, not proof of independent sampling or global transfer. Household and other same-city scenarios never become extra samples.
cohort_rule: Coverage thresholds are predeclared observation-selection sensitivities, not retrospective exclusions from primary. Retain every eligible fold;require at least10 training cities and2 provinces per fit,otherwise mark whole cohort unscored with reason and retain its records. No comparison across cohorts described as same-target improvement.
metrics: Pooled held-province predictions:mean absolute log error,root mean square log error,median multiplicative error exp(median absolute log error),and equal-province mean absolute log error. Report paired per-province absolute-log-error differences versus constant,not just pooled winner. No selection/adoption threshold;all models remain visible.
controls: Household3/5/7 shifts density and predictions by same log factor:held-out errors must remain identical within1e-12. Verify population prediction = density_prediction * site_area * household only as conditional algebra,not observed inhabitants. Source PDF/CSV,prior outputs,atlas model packet hashes unchanged;no climate solve,placement,resource or staff defaults changed.
review: Independent scalar normal equations and explicit2x2 centered solve (no producer lstsq),independent fold membership and metrics,all predictions and coefficients,source hashes,household invariance and fresh byte-exact replay. Numerical unit checks prevent held-out target leakage and rank-deficient fits. Publish chart/report/downloads in normal evidence page and post chart in chat.
limits_and_next: Results cannot repair missing sample phases,contemporaneous extents,detection or site representativeness. Keep allAD150 qualification gates;no calibrated resident requests reach allocator. Review whole programme after completion. Next prioritize compatible phase/extent evidence or concrete complete-resource/work dependencies;keep releases1-4,S1-S5,allactors/unaffiliated/mobile/nonstate and failedVidarbha guard intact. No repeated exponent tuning to manufacture qualification.
